tasks.label: ТВОЯ РОЛЬ
tasks.q: Стефан привів тебе й Олену туди, де все почалося. Він розповідає правду, яку ховав 145 років: після смерті саме він змусив Деймона завершити перетворення. Деймон хотів померти. Стефан не дав. Тепер ви сидите на холодному камені й думаєте: що він мав зробити? Що міг би зробити?
tasks.q_pl: Stefan przyprowadził ciebie i Elenę tam, gdzie wszystko się zaczęło. Opowiada prawdę, którą ukrywał 145 lat: po śmierci to on zmusił Damona do dokończenia przemiany. Damon chciał umrzeć. Stefan nie pozwolił. Teraz siedzicie na zimnym kamieniu i myślicie: co powinien był zrobić? Co mógł zrobić?
tasks.q_en: Stefan has brought you and Elena to where it all began. He's telling the truth he has hidden for 145 years: after they died, he was the one who forced Damon to complete the transition. Damon wanted to die. Stefan wouldn't let him. Now you sit on a cold stone and wonder: what should he have done? What could he have done?

tasks.label: ПРАВИЛО
tasks.q: Past modals: modal + have + past participle. should have / shouldn't have = criticism or regret (He shouldn't have forced him). could have = a possibility that didn't happen (He could have let him go). might/may have = maybe it happened (He might have been happier). must have = I'm sure it happened (Damon must have suffered). can't have = I'm sure it didn't.
tasks.q_pl: Past modals: modal + have + past participle. should have / shouldn't have = criticism or regret (He shouldn't have forced him). could have = a possibility that didn't happen (He could have let him go). might/may have = maybe it happened (He might have been happier). must have = I'm sure it happened (Damon must have suffered). can't have = I'm sure it didn't.

end_good.title: Місію виконано!
end_good.text: Деймон дивиться на брата довго і мовчки. Потім розвертається і йде. Але цього разу він не каже нічого злого.
end_good.text_pl: Damon długo i w milczeniu patrzy na brata. Potem się odwraca i odchodzi. Ale tym razem nie mówi nic złośliwego.
end_good.text_en: Damon looks at his brother for a long time in silence. Then he turns and walks away. But this time he says nothing cruel.
